system.description:
• Effect: On a successful hit, the target takes normal weapon damage. Each subsequent round they lose 1d6 HP from blood loss unless healed or bandaged.
  • Bleeding is cumulative
  • Only usable before the target has acted this encounter
  • Maximum four Slow Kill strikes on a single target per encounter — after four hits all vulnerable areas have been struck
  • Works with Sneak Attack simultaneously

activities.name: Slow Kill
activities.text: Before the target has acted, a hit leaves it bleeding 1d6 HP each round until healed or bandaged; bleeding stacks, 1d6 for each Slow Kill strike, up to four strikes per target per encounter. Not against creatures that don't bleed.

activities.name: Bleed
activities.text: The target loses 1d6 HP from blood loss at the start of the round, for each Slow Kill strike on it (roll once per strike).

activities.name: Cripple Limb
activities.text: The Assassin picks a limb; the target saves against the Class Save DC or loses use of it until healed. Not against creatures that don't bleed.
